title: Inter Top of Serie A — But Chivu Said They Were Lucky | Nerazzurri Daily 58
description:
Inter are top of Serie A on 25 points from nine — and their own coach called it luck.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=58

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Chivu to Sky Sport Italia, Oct 28: "Siamo stati fortunati oggi nel portarla a casa" — we were lucky today to bring it home.
REPORTED — Gazzetta dello Sport, Oct 27: talks over Federico Dimarco's new deal have not moved since September. His contract runs to 2027.
NEXT UP — AC Milan away, Sat Oct 31, Serie A Matchday 10, 3:45 PM ET / 20:45 CET, US TV: Paramount+ and Telemundo.
